text:
Alex Cheng: Heads-up — overnight we had a recurrent Xid/ECC spike on rack-4. Started ~02:10 UTC, ~2hr window, mostly on gpunode-r4-03 and -05. Looks like uncorrected ECC + Xid 13/17 combos.

Marta Gomez: saw the alert in grafana. ECC uncorrected went from 0 -> double digits on those two nodes.

Sam Irons: quick query I ran:
```sql
SELECT node, error_code, count(*) FROM gpu_error_events
WHERE timestamp > to_timestamp(1768998000) AND rack = 'rack-4'
GROUP BY node, error_code;
```
results show error_code 13 and 17 concentrated on r4-03/05, also higher-than-usual temp variance.

Lei Wu: sharing `nvidia-smi -q -d ECC,UTILIZATION` dumps from r4-03: 
```
[gpunode-r4-03] nvidia-smi -q -d ECC,UTILIZATION
Product Name : Tesla-A100-SXM4-40GB
ECC Errors
    Volatile
        GPU Ecc Mode                    : Enabled
        Device Memory
            Total : Corrected 0  Uncorrected 12
        Other: Xid 13: 7  Xid 17: 5
Utilization
    Gpu                         : 8 %
    Memory                      : 4 %
```

Marta Gomez: dmesg lines from r4-03 around first spike: `NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 13, PID 2145, GPU 00000000:65:00:00` repeated.

Taylan: those serials map to vendor batch B-2019 per inventory. We flagged a small cluster of returns last quarter that looked flaky.

Alex Cheng: initial triage notes:
- pattern: uncorrected ECC + Xid 13/17 on specific serials in rack-4
- affected nodes: gpunode-r4-03, gpunode-r4-05 (possible >1 card per node)
- impact: degraded throughput for jobs pinned to those nodes, autoscaler rebalanced but some timeouts occurred

ops-bot: Incident created INC-7892 by Marta Gomez — severity: high (resource degradation).

Sam Irons: suggested next steps: short-term drain + reprovision, collect full hardware logs (ipmitool sdr, ECC dumps, nvml logs), file RMA with vendor referencing batch id B-2019.

Lei Wu: I can pull IPMI sensor history and power cycle traces. Preliminary check shows one node had a ~50W jump at 02:12 UTC. Could be power rail instability or failing card drawing more current.

Marta Gomez: can we quick-canary replace one GPU on r4-03 tomorrow morning? Want to validate whether swap reduces Xid rate before RMA'ing whole batch.

Alex Cheng: plan I'd propose: 
1) Immediately cordon gpunode-r4-03 and -05 from scheduling (mark drain).
2) Re-schedule running pods to other racks (we'll accept temporary cost spike).
3) Run hardware-level repro script to try to reproduce in maintenance window: stress-mem + ECC-monitor for 1hr.
4) If repro consistent, swap in known-good card on r4-03 (canary).
5) If canary clears errors, open RMA for the remainder of B-2019 serials and schedule bulk replacements.
6) Add telemetry alert rule: if uncorrected ECC >= 5 within 1h on same serial -> auto-cordon.

Jay (oncall): I can own the drain/cordon tonight if needed (after 22:00 UTC). Tagging me for hands-on swap with ops team.

Taylan: will start RMA ticket draft: include `INC-7892`, list of serials: SN-B2019-045, SN-B2019-052, SN-B2019-078 (from asset DB). Also include `dmesg`, `nvidia-smi` dumps and the power trace.

Alex Cheng: Logging action items: 
- Alex: Schedule canary swap & run repro script (ETA 2026-03-19 09:00 UTC).
- Jay: night drain if we see another spike (oncall).
- Taylan: start RMA draft + vendor contact.
- Lei: collect IPMI logs + power traces and attach to INC-7892.
- Sam: add auto-cordon rule to infra playbook (PR to infra-monitoring).

Marta Gomez: +1 on the auto-cordon rule. Also let's add a dashboard panel to show serial->error mapping so we can spot bad batches faster.

Alex Cheng: one more note — check if those nodes are on the same PSU PDUs and trunk (rack-4 PDU-2). If it's the PDU we should see errors across multiple cards. Lei, can you confirm?

Lei Wu: checked PDU logs quickly, no anomalies in aggregate power for PDU-2. So leaning toward card-level failures not PDU-wide.

Sam Irons: if we see recurring issues across rack-4 after replacements, escalate to board-level warranty claim and consider blacklisting vendor batch in procurement for 6 months.

ops-bot: INC-7892 updated: assigned -> Alex Cheng; attachments: nvidia-smi_dumps.tar.gz, dmesg_excerpt.txt, ipmi_history.csv

Alex Cheng: thanks all. We'll update this thread after the canary swap. If anyone sees fresh Xid/ECC spikes tonight, @Jay please escalate immediately. :thumbsup:
